description:
On a mysterious continent is where Le Han is located, a scholar city at the junction of 3 countries and famous for preserving peace on the continent. A school called Zhenyan exists since antiquity and welcomes individuals who possess great strength.

We follow the scholarship of three students.

(Source: Nautiljon)
